# The Morning Sun

> Local news, sports, weather, and community information for Mount Pleasant, Michigan and Isabella County.

The Morning Sun is a community news source serving Mount Pleasant and the surrounding Isabella County region in Michigan. The site provides comprehensive coverage of local news, high school sports, weather updates, and community events for residents of central Michigan.

## Key Topics

- Mount Pleasant
- Isabella County
- Michigan news
- Local news
- Sports coverage
- High school sports
- Weather updates
- Community events
- Crime reports
- Beal City
- Remus
- Ithaca
- Upper Peninsula
- Subscription management
- Account authentication

- [The Morning Sun – Mount Pleasant, MI News, Sports, Weather, Things to Do](https://www.themorningsun.com): Homepage for Mount Pleasant, Michigan local news, sports, weather and community events
